scope: P1i common-task external baseline comparison; valid_iid only until a separate test-unlock protocol

primary_external_contrasts.question: Does the frozen Heat3D mechanism improve the common task relative to GINO?
Does the frozen Heat3D mechanism improve the common task relative to Transolver?

contextual_contrasts.question: How does the shared RIGNO implementation compare with GINO?
How does the shared RIGNO implementation compare with Transolver?

descriptive_only_contrasts.question: What descriptive difference is observed between the two external baselines?

not_allowed: re-ranking the primary contrasts after results are observed
treating the descriptive GINO-versus-Transolver contrast as a primary claim
using the hierarchy to remove a seed, change a metric, change a checkpoint, or change a training budget

frozen_statistics.checkpoint_selection: valid_iid sample_first_relative_rmse_pct; per-seed minimum, earliest epoch tie
frozen_statistics.secondary_metrics: existing configs/heat3d_v7/v7_metric_contract.json contract after physical-space decode
frozen_statistics.paired_unit: same valid_iid sample evaluated by paired models under each seed

analysis_guards.common_formal_gate: GINO optimized-backend gate must be ORIGINAL_GATE_PASS or receive a separately approved semantic-equivalence amendment; existing Transolver CUDA preflight remains PASS
